title: He Paid 10,000 Bitcoin For Two Pizzas 🍕
caption:
True story. In 2010 a programmer paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas, the first known real-world bitcoin purchase. 🍕
Would you have kept the coins? 👇
first_comment: Those pizzas cost him hundreds of millions. Was it the worst or the best pizza ever? 🍕👇
